data.title: 毛利兰 · 空手道社的晨训
data.description: 清晨道场，她扎起头发穿着道服练习正拳，动作干净利落；朝阳从道场高窗斜照进来，汗水与呼出的白气——「主将」二字的说服力全在这一帧。

data.promptProse: Ran Mouri practices a clean straight punch in the dawn dojo, tied hair clear of her properly wrapped white gi and black belt. Her stance remains grounded through the white martial-arts trousers, breath briefly visible after the movement. The medium portrait includes the wooden floor and high window behind her working arm. Slanting morning sun catches forehead sweat and the gi folds, casting a long arm shadow toward the quieter side of the room.
